title: EU AUTOPILOT project: Platooning use case in Brainport
authors: Antoine Schmeitz | Ramon S. Schwartz | Daan Ravesteijn | Geert Verhaeg | Daniel Altgassen | Harry Wedemeijer
source_version: 13th ITS European Congress, June 2019, paper ITS-TP1800. SHA256 eb8c476716d451b1728764503e9fe636fcc9675ccf5301824b98e915c5662e62
evidence: Authors report 63 executed/evaluated and 42 successful out of 62 in adjacent statements. Their short-range UWB/ITS-G5 delay is 3–7 ms inclusive of software processing. Cars can open and close the gap after a cut-in. Cloud IoT messages without MEC are excluded from the direct platooning loop in their design.
rights_and_limitations: Public congress PDF. No redistribution license verified; summary only. Test-population denominators differ, and plotted trials are not identified here as identical to the audited files.

title: D.4.3 Final Technical Evaluation
authors: AUTOPILOT consortium | IDIADA (lead participant and editor) | Alexander Velizhev et al.
source_version: D4.3 v1.1, grant agreement 731993, 23 December 2019. SHA256 ffd4dd77e989be3ddb32b0b0c8d6fc5a6e847baf4ea46bab7264bf7f45dd176b
evidence: Livorno hazard is generated by bicycle IMU, sent via ITS-G5 DENM and cloud services. The authors describe speed decrease and stop, and report average maximum jerk –0.0118 m/s³ for IoT-on VRU detection.
rights_and_limitations: Public technical deliverable (dissemination level PU). No redistribution license established; summary only. Figure-level evaluation alone does not align per-vehicle clocks or demonstrate causal latency.

title: Exploring Wi-Fi Network Diversity for Vehicle-to-Infrastructure Communication
authors: Rui Meireles | António Rodrigues | Andrei Stanciu | Ana Aguiar | Peter Steenkiste
locator: §II, Experimental Data Collection, Table I and Fig. 2
evidence: A moving car with three radio interfaces made repeated circuits past stationary access points; separate 2.4 GHz control link ran NTP. A 1 Hz table merges monitor and application data. The two collection days differed in AP vehicle height and driving pattern.
rights_and_limitations: Public author copy; IEEE paper copyright. Only original summaries and derived measurements included. Corpus does not support one-way V2V packet latency.
